tasks.subject: Task 6: Stop normalizeDatePageCleanLayoutHtml from flattening the new pagination
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Remove the expandDateTimelineHtml call from the serve-time cleanup pipeline so #events-more/#births-more/#deaths-more survive being served, on both cache miss and cache hit.

**Files:**
- Modify: js/seo-worker.js:5883-5885
- Test: tools/born-died-era-cards.test.js:175-218

**Verify:** node --test tools/born-died-era-cards.test.js

**Context:** commit 797e9f9 (2026-07-28) deliberately removed this exact pagination pattern and added expandDateTimelineHtml to flatten it in cached HTML. That function also runs on freshly generated HTML, so it would silently undo Tasks 3-5 without this fix. User was informed and explicitly approved reintroducing the pattern (2026-07-30). Keep this change minimal/isolated (1 line) for easy revert if needed.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["js/seo-worker.js", "tools/born-died-era-cards.test.js"], "verifyCommand": "node --test tools/born-died-era-cards.test.js", "acceptanceCriteria": ["normalizeDatePageCleanLayoutHtml no longer calls expandDateTimelineHtml", "expandDateTimelineHtml stays defined and exported, not deleted", "a synthetic #births-more wrap survives normalizeDatePageCleanLayoutHtml unmerged while all other cleanup behaviors are unaffected"]}
```
